pride_data.title: Assesing Orthogonality of ER-HRP and cyt-APEX proximity labeling
pride_data.projectDescription: This project was evaluating the orthogonality of proximity labeling peroxidases that are used to determine partitioning of proteins between the ER and the cytosol.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: HEK293T cells were transfected with either APEX2.NES or ER.HRP and treated with either 50 nM MG132 and either vehicle or 25 nM mycolactone for 16h. Following proximity biotinylation with biotin-phenol and peroxide, labeling was quenched and biotinylated proteins were avidin-purified from lysate. Eluates were prepared for shotgun proteomics, TMT-labeled, and characterized by MuDPIT on an LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro interfaced with a Thermo nLC1000. Both MS1 (30000) and MS2 (7500) were acquired in the Orbitrap, with 30s dynamic exclusion, 1.0 Da isolation window, and stepped collision voltage HCD.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: Raw files were converted to mzml files using MSConvert and searched in FragPipe against a 07/11/2021 Uniprot release (longest entry for each protein group) with 20429 proteins plus reverse sequences and common contaminants, with a FDR of 0.01 at the peptide level. TMT modification on N-termini and lysine, as well as cysteine alkylation, were included as fixed modifications. Methionine oxidation, biotin-phenol addition at tyrosine and N-terminal acetylation were included as variable modifications.
